2609.00925.title: Context-Grounding Gains Are Mediated by Pre-existing Machinery: Auditing GRPO, SFT, and DPO
2609.00925.paper_summary: Language models can ignore prompt evidence when it conflicts with memorized knowledge. Post-training can make models follow such evidence more reliably, but it is unclear whether these gains require new machinery or strengthen machinery already present. We compare nine post-training arms spanning GRPO, SFT, and DPO from one starting checkpoint, with key comparisons extended across scales and families. We estimate a grounding direction from that checkpoint before training. Across five tested GRPO variants, grounding gains are small. For the two variants replicated across seeds, equivalence tests bound their effects below the conflict-SFT gain even as the rewarded metric improves. Conflict-SFT improves grounding moderately, while DPO drives grounding near ceiling on its matched distribution. Conflict-SFT and DPO largely use the same causal attention-head set as the starting model. Subtracting the starting-model direction suppresses both gains, while adding it to the starting model recovers 35% of DPO's gain at a dose passing all stated side-effect checks. After a supervised warm start makes the context answer appear in more rollouts, the same GRPO recipe adds essentially no further grounding gain. In our setting, grounding gains largely depend on machinery already present in the starting model.
2609.00925.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型在面對與記憶知識衝突的提示證據時，可以選擇忽略這些證據。後訓練可以使模型更可靠地遵循這些證據，但尚不清楚這些增益是否需要新的機制或是加強已存在的機制。我們比較了從一個起始檢查點出發的九個後訓練方法，涵蓋了GRPO、SFT和DPO，並在不同的規模和家族之間擴展了關鍵比較。我們從該檢查點估計了訓練前的基準方向。在五個測試的GRPO變體中，基準增益很小。對於在不同隨機種子下重複的兩個變體，等效性測試將它們的影響限制在低於衝突-SFT增益的範圍內，即使獲獎指標有所改善。衝突-SFT適度改善基準，而DPO則使基準在其匹配分佈上接近上限。衝突-SFT和DPO在很大程度上使用與起始模型相同的因果注意力頭集。減去起始模型方向會抑制這兩個增益，而將其添加到起始模型則恢復了DPO增益的35%，並通過了所有聲明的副作用檢查。在經過監督的熱啟動使上下文答案在更多的回合中出現後，相同的GRPO配方幾乎沒有增加進一步的基準增益。在我們的設定中，基準增益在很大程度上依賴於起始模型中已存在的機制。
2609.00925.author: Prakhar Gupta et.al.
